# lettermint_domains (Data Source)

List Lettermint domains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lettermint_domains" "verified" {
  status = "verified"
  sort   = ["domain"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String)
- `page_size` (Number) Results requested per API page. The API default is 30.
- `project_id` (String)
- `sort` (List of String) Sort values in API order. The API default is -created_at.
- `status` (String)

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
